smell_validity.evidence: Orchestration methods absorbed their delegates' bodies: a three-level stacked listing copy inside the reconciliation hot path, five mutation-site embeds, and the ~90-line legacy commit body duplicated twice, while the original helper definitions remain behind. Transport rules and policy logic are unmistakably interleaved; the design cost and boundary from healthy delegation are visible without the smell label.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Every network-facing operation now lives in about fourteen scattered inline copies while the named owner methods sit dead in the file. An ordinary edit to endpoints, auth, or error wording applied at the apparent owner silently misses production traffic, and modern and legacy paths drift apart. Restoring single ownership removes a counterfeit-authority trap across the whole pipeline.

development_plausibility.evidence: The copies use natural Rust pasting mechanics — receiver renames, config-slice adapters, match-scrutinee block integration, existing ppfmt/emoji messaging — inside a believable performance-sprint inlining story. Faint artificial regularity remains: the same recipe applied with suspicious completeness to every layer, including a small detection routine, with every original definition deliberately retained.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: The prompt names every inlined operation and all three layers, requires exactly one owning implementation with orchestration delegating through it, orders removal of scaffolding feeding the copies, and fences CLI, config, message wording, endpoint shapes, and dry-run behavior. That directly blocks partial cleanup, behavior-changing consolidation, and unrelated redesign while leaving internal restructuring free.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct purposes need different integration decisions: collapsing the three-level listing stack into one filtered-listing call, result-discarding reconnection at five mutation sites, match-scrutinee reconstruction with early-return semantics for WAF lookup, and two-level legacy unrolling with argument reconstruction. The detection-arm revert, however, adds no decision beyond the generic reconnection rule.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt's operation inventory supplies most of the scope; finishing requires walking each retained helper's chain — request primitive through listing, filtering, reconciliation, or commit_record through update_ips to the batch — to match every embedded copy, including five sites inside one method. Classification stays file-local, with no cross-component combination or exclusion traps.

repair_coordination.evidence: Every embed site reconnects to a still-existing, behavior-identical helper, so one reconnection rule governs all sites and partial repairs do not break each other at runtime. The legacy nest orders the work — update_ips must regain commit_record delegation — but each site remains locally correct independently.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Every duplicated definition survives with unchanged semantics, so one uniform rule — replace each embedded block with a call to the helper whose body it reproduces, then drop adapter locals — covers all roughly fourteen locations. Bindings and arguments are adapted per site, but no behavioral decision is needed anywhere; reconnection preserves observable behavior.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Reconnecting the reconciliation block to the unfiltered listing helper instead of the name-filtered one compiles and type-checks identically, passing ordinary runs and failing only where a zone hosts same-type records under other names. Error-wording and dry-run edits are similarly silent. No test coverage is evidenced, so two distinct unchecked failure paths are not established.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
